script.title: Why Quick Commerce Apps Now Ship Wedding Gear #shorts

segments.text: Forgot your wedding safa? Quick commerce apps will deliver it in ten minutes.
From shadi chunris to silver thalis, platforms like Zepto and Blinkit are now rushing into last-minute wedding shopping.
But why are grocery delivery apps betting on wedding emergencies? It all comes down to average order value.
A ₹50 milk packet yields barely two rupees in profit. But a ₹3,000 wedding dupatta packs massive profit margins.
Desperate hosts buy without comparing prices, helping delivery apps finally cover high logistics costs.
So next time someone forgets a key item at the venue, remember...

script.description: Quick commerce apps in India are moving beyond milk and veggies into high-margin wedding shopping. Here is the economic strategy behind 10-minute wedding deliveries. #business #quickcommerce #india

facts_to_verify.claim: Quick-commerce platforms in India are experiencing surging demand for last-minute wedding items.
FMCG grocery items like milk yield low single-digit margins (around ₹2 per packet), whereas fashion and festive items offer significantly higher gross margins.
